title: React Patterns with TypeScript
description: Learn common React patterns implemented with TypeScript.
longDescription: This module applies everything you have learned about TypeScript to real-world React patterns that appear in every production application. You will build type-safe context providers for global state, typed data-fetching hooks with React Query, validated forms with React Hook Form, type-safe routing, compound component APIs, and error boundaries that classify and recover from failures. Each pattern is introduced progressively with full working code, comparison tables, and hands-on exercises that reinforce the underlying type mechanics.
whatYouLearn: Type data fetching with React Query
